get.summary: employee.reportAttendance (export): attendance sheet in minutes per employee and month (D05, same numbers as GET /employees/{id}/attendance). A month HR closed is read from its stored snapshot (hash re-verified, D07), an open month is computed from live data; `periodState` says which. Ordered by employee code, id, month. XLSX twin of the report: the same action, the same query statement and snapshot (no `limit`/`offset`: a file is the whole scoped set), one flat sheet with Vietnamese headers, typed cells (numbers, dates), no company template; text is always a text cell (a name starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` is not a formula). The caller is authorized again after the file is rendered and before it is delivered (403 `error.accessDenied`, also for a caller with no report role, never an empty file). 422 `error.exportTooLarge`: more than 5000 rows in the caller’s scope or a file over 5 MiB — refused, never cut. Fixed file name from the report and its range; `Cache-Control: no-store`. If the client disconnects nothing more is done and nothing is stored.
